signal: Tessell raised $60M Series B and is launching an AI-powered conversational database management service while expanding into Europe and Asia-Pacific.

email.body1:
Carlo, saw Tessell raised $60M Series B and is launching conversational database management while expanding into new regions.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the new number
email.body2:
Carlo, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise, board expectations on enterprise pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tessell needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Carlo, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Carlo, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-expansion stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
